__meta.purpose: ARCH-016-SHOPIFY-002 Attempt 2 deterministic Recovery Settings translation handoff
instructions: For each locale below, copy every key/value pair in its recoverySettings map into app/i18n/locales/<locale>.json.
Treat these strings as architect-provided copy. Do not translate, paraphrase, rename keys, or change ICU placeholder names.
This map is the complete recoverySettings.* namespace required by Attempt 2. Existing non-recoverySettings keys must remain unchanged.
Use i18n.formatDateTime for date values before passing them as {value}; do not hard-code English date labels in JSX.
